tasks.short: Interpret production documents and explain requirements to workers

steps.what: Retrieve current specifications, blueprints, orders and company procedures
Interpret specifications and procedures for the actual production job
Explain job requirements and clarify workers' questions

tasks.design: Configure native production-job links in {OPS_SYSTEM} to the released material in {DOCS}. Retrieval becomes slightly shorter; the supervisor still interprets the actual documents and explains their implications directly to workers.
tasks.previous_blocker: Related released documents require repeated navigation.
tasks.enabler_now: Native job-to-document links can expose the correct revisions.
tasks.still_hard: Ambiguous geometry, conflicting instructions and practical constraints require technical judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The supervisor translates a requirement into an instruction the worker understands and can apply.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: production jobs can link released documents; native retrieval does not interpret their technical meaning.

assumptions: Boundary is retrieval, interpretation and live explanation. A new work instruction, engineering change or separate written dispatch is not established here; add actual document/record/send work if required rather than hiding it in the conversation or inventing a log.

Engineering and document control already supply job identifier, drawing/specification identifier, revision, release status and applicable policy category. s1 verifies these and manually traces missing links; no new tagging or extraction is assumed free.

Native links first. Only 1.5 points of document navigation disappear from s1; 13.5 points of revision checks, reading and manual fallback remain. Interpretation and explanation retain all time. Existing system runtime earns no labour saving.
Shares and upkeep are provisional model estimates.
unknowns: Whether native document links already exist
research_questions: Can the link preserve revision and release warnings?
Time navigation separately from interpretation and explanation

already_counted.description: Document revision verification and manual missing-link tracing.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Central removes 1.5 navigation points less 0.4 upkeep. Conservative newly revised procedure needs manual register tracing and leaves only 0.6 point of direct retrieval reusable, giving 0.2 net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Observe operators and production indicators against standards

steps.what: Review applicable processing limits and operating standards
Observe work and monitor gauges, dials and indicators
Judge conformance and instruct operators about deviations

tasks.design: Keep the supervisor's observation of actual work and equipment indicators. The existing limits in {DOCS} remain the reference; an already-running gauge or a new display does not by itself remove the human conformance check.
tasks.previous_blocker: The task depends on observing process behaviour in its physical context.
tasks.enabler_now: No labour-removing change to the observed work is established.
tasks.still_hard: Normal readings can coexist with unsafe technique or poor product handling.
tasks.human_edge: The supervisor recognises a process deviation that an isolated indicator misses.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: live work observation and interpretation of existing indicators require process context; existing instrument runtime is not supervisor labour.

assumptions: Boundary is routine observation and live correction, not a separately required quality report or incident investigation. Actual deviations requiring a written record, escalation or machine-setting change need their own priced actions when included.

Process engineering already supplies standards and limits; s1 includes obtaining, reading and manually clarifying them. The supervisor directly observes the work and indicators; no new structured operator behaviour or camera feed is assumed.

Before choosing zero, separate standards review from observation and inspect actual lookup, record and send duties. A template does not remove reading these limits, and no repeated digital comparison or required routine observation log is established. Do not add one merely to create a saving.
No technology or capture is introduced, so incremental upkeep is zero. Shares are model estimates of the supervisor's time; operator work stays outside the saving.
unknowns: Existing indicator aggregation and observation requirements
research_questions: Observe a conformance round and separately identify any real recorded finding or escalation

incremental.description: No new system or capture is introduced for routine observation.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Standards review, physical observation and conformance judgement remain fully retained. No removable manual record, comparison or send is established in this routine round.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Direct and coordinate production workers and assignments

steps.what: Review current production jobs, capacity and work status
Observe work progress and resolve immediate production constraints
Decide priorities and coordinate inspectors, setters and fabricators
Update the existing production assignment board
Brief workers on final assignments and clarify handovers

tasks.design: Configure the native production board in {OPS_SYSTEM} to retain relevant status filters and reuse existing job identifiers during assignment updates. The supervisor still observes, chooses priorities, directs workers and briefs handovers; the board update is an ordinary internal record, not an autonomous allocation decision.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated status navigation and job identifier entry interrupt direct coordination.
tasks.enabler_now: Native board views and linked job selection can reduce these specific interactions.
tasks.still_hard: Changing bottlenecks, worker capability and unexpected defects need direct judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The supervisor coordinates a practical response to the actual shop-floor situation.
tasks.altitude: Assignment authority stays with the supervisor.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native production boards can retain status filters and link assignments to jobs; this design does not use behaviour-based worker allocation.

assumptions: Boundary is direct coordination already using a production assignment board that workers consult. No new worker monitoring or assignment log is introduced. A site without this board needs different weights, rather than an invented record baseline.

Existing order planning supplies job identifier, operation, due date and capacity; operators' existing work supplies status. s1 verifies and manually traces missing/stale data. s3 decides assignments. No new status capture or data maintenance is transferred free to workers.

Native filters and job-linked entry first. s1 removes three navigation points and retains 17 for status reading and exceptions. s4 removes one point of identifier repetition and retains nine for original assignment details, checking, repair and ordinary ungated saving. All observation, priority decisions and briefings remain retained.

There is no separate automatic message. Actual electronic dispatches, if required in addition to the live briefing, need their own priced and gated actions. Shares and upkeep are provisional model estimates.
unknowns: Current board use and native links
Actual stale-status and identifier repair effort
research_questions: Does the board retain visibility of missing or stale work status?
Time identifier entry separately from assignment judgement

already_counted.description: Status checking, manual missing-data tracing and original assignment entry/repair.

incremental.description: Maintain status filters and job-linked assignment fields.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Central removes three navigation and one identifier point less 0.8 upkeep. Conservative unplanned new job has incomplete board links, leaving one navigation and 0.3 identifier point reusable, giving 0.5 net. Direction and briefing do not shrink.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Conduct practical equipment and safety training and record actual completion

steps.what: Review the worker's training need and current equipment procedures
Prepare the existing procedure handout and teaching examples
Check training instructions and prepare safe demonstration equipment
Train workers through equipment demonstrations and safety explanations
Observe worker practice and give corrective instruction
Enter and check the existing worker training-completion record

tasks.design: For training personally delivered by the supervisor, use native {DOCS} handout layouts for existing material. Keep technical examples, safety checks, demonstration, coaching and the actual completion entry in {LMS}; no automatic competence decision or certificate release is introduced.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated handout headings and arrangement consume a small amount of preparation.
tasks.enabler_now: A native layout can reuse the established teaching format.
tasks.still_hard: Safe performance and understanding require direct demonstration and observation.
tasks.human_edge: The supervisor corrects unsafe technique and knows whether more practice is needed.
tasks.altitude: Training and completion-record responsibility stay unchanged.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native handout layouts can shorten repeated preparation while equipment teaching and actual training records remain human work.

assumptions: This is the personally-conduct-training branch, already using a procedure handout and required training-completion register. Supervisors use that register to verify who received instruction. Do not add it if absent locally; the delegate-to-experienced-worker branch needs its own actual assignment and record weights.

s1 selects worker identifier, training requirement and procedure revision from existing records. s2 includes original examples and manual capture of teaching content; s5 produces observed practice outcome. s6 captures actual worker, trainer, procedure, date and outcome only after practice. No new capture is free or assumed before its producer.

Native layout first. Two points of repeated headings/arrangement disappear from s2; eight points of content preparation, examples and layout repair remain. s3 retains full procedure checks and safe equipment setup. More repair lowers the estimate.

s6 is an existing original completion entry, not a new log or authority certificate. All entry/check/save time remains retained and ungated. Formal authorisation, certificates or actual messages, if required, need separate steps and gates after final versions exist. Shares are model estimates.
unknowns: Existing handout and completion register use
Whether formal equipment authorisation is separate
research_questions: Does the template preserve all current warnings and revisions?
Time layout separately from demonstrations and actual completion entry

already_counted.description: Original examples, layout repair, complete safety/setup checks and original training record entry.

incremental.description: Maintain handout layouts against procedure revision changes.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Central removes two specific layout points less 0.6 upkeep. Conservative unfamiliar equipment requires new illustrations and warnings, leaving only 0.9 point of recurring headings reusable, giving 0.3 net. Training and original completion recording remain retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: A production supervisor retaining technical interpretation, direct observation, coordination and training, with small reductions in explicit navigation and document arrangement.
skills_to_grow: Maintain procedure templates without changing technical content
role.ambitious_version: Support direct shop-floor supervision with current information and modest native configuration rather than new tracking or invented paperwork.

job.title: First-Line Supervisors of Production and Operating Workers
